original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非两起大规模枪击事件致27人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非在数小时内发生两起大规模枪击事件，共造成27人死亡、26人受伤。约翰内斯堡附近一酒吧遭八名枪手袭击，造成17人死亡；开普敦附近一乡镇娱乐场所外另有10人遇害。警方尚未给出明确作案动机，且两案均未有人被捕。

key_facts.fact: 约翰内斯堡附近一酒吧遭八名枪手袭击，17人死亡、15人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Seventeen people were killed when eight gunmen stormed a bar close to Johannesburg on Saturday evening, with 15 more injured.

key_facts.fact: 开普敦附近一乡镇娱乐场所外发生枪击，10人死亡、11人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 10 people were killed outside an entertainment venue in a township near Cape Town and a further 11 were injured.

key_facts.fact: 警方尚未给出两起袭击的明确动机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police have not given a definitive motive for either of the latest attacks.

key_facts.fact: 截至周日上午两起案件均未有人被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: No arrests had been made in either case on Sunday morning.
